meta.crn_note: Exogenous RNG (seed) is 100% policy-independent across paired seeds. Outage RNG (seed+1) draws 1 Uniform(0,1) per available unit per day in fixed unit order (gas, coal, nuclear, renewable); identical across policies until a trip occurs, deterministic per seed.

mechanism_diagnosis.explanation: In R3 (r3_interior.py), fast_dispatch uses a greedy merit-order fast path (_fast_merit_dispatch) without a VOLL shedding block and only falls back to the LP (dc_opf) when line limits, reserve, or load balance fail. At peak-adjacent steps where reserve remains feasible despite mu > mu_hi_g (excess_cost > VOLL), legacy fast_dispatch erroneously dispatches ~550-610 MWh of above-VOLL excess on gas/coal instead of preemptively shedding load, building wear W~0.08-0.19 and causing trips on 2/5 R3 seeds (seeds 2 and 5). Under the exact LP (dc_opf / VOLL-gated fast_dispatch), gas and coal accrue 0.0 MWh excess, shed_cap (30%) never binds, only 6.2 MWh of step-0..2 ramp-forced nuclear excess occurs (from initial prev_p[2]=190 > free[2]=170 with ramp=5 MW/step, decaying to W<2e-4 before the day-1 outage check), and trips drop to 0 across all test seeds.
